aggregation: Unit of dependence is day, not60 independent events. Daily correlations n=6 are coarse. Report median/Q1/Q3/min/max/count, full daily values, earlier5/recent5, leave-one-day-out ranges. No p-values/significance claim.
authorization: User requested continuation of market-state-based research after baseline report
causality: Point-in-time feature availability only. Association does not establish a causal market mechanism. Last response endpoints are not executable fills.

consistency_gate.H1: All10 daily correlations defined; overall,earlier5,recent5 daily-rho medians and every leave-one-day-out daily-rho median >0
consistency_gate.H2: H1-style positive-rho consistency plus all60 forecast pairs defined and mean error improvement >0 overall,earlier5,recent5 and every leave-one-day-out mean
consistency_gate.interpretation: A descriptive screening convention only, not statistical significance, causal proof, OOS success or strategy adoption. Gate miss does not authorize flipping to contrarian or retuning.

design_reason: Fixed hourly grid covers the session without selecting the previously highlighted10:00-10:30 interval. One30minute scale and one1minute gap, no sweep.

hypotheses.auxiliary: Pooled and same-clock Spearman as diagnostics, plus continued/reversed/neutral counts. No ranking clocks.
hypotheses.continuation: Past net=0 excluded as direction undefined; future net=0 counted neutral; continuation fraction=continued/all past-nonzero events, including neutral outcomes.
hypotheses.mechanism: Persistent directional pressure may continue across nearby periods; the pressure itself is not identified in Last data.
hypotheses.primary: Median of daily Spearman correlations over the six fixed clocks; report valid days and each day
hypotheses.question: Does signed prior30minute directional efficiency associate positively with subsequent30minute signed log price change?

hypotheses.auxiliary: Pooled/same-clock correlations, earlier5/recent5 summaries, leave-one-day-out mean improvement. No multiplier fitting.
hypotheses.control: Same-clock prior5 response RMS median alone
hypotheses.fixed_forecast: Same-clock prior5 response RMS median * x; multiplier exponent/coefficient fixed1, not fitted
hypotheses.forecast_diagnostic: For each day mean absolute error over six events, then equal-day mean improvement=controlMAE-fixedForecastMAE. Positive means smaller error.
hypotheses.mechanism: Clustering of price-movement scale may help risk measurement, without predicting buy/sell direction.
hypotheses.primary: Median daily Spearman across six fixed clocks
hypotheses.question: Does relative prior30minute RMS movement predict relative subsequent30minute RMS movement?
hypotheses.x: Prior RMS / median prior5 sessions same-clock prior RMS
hypotheses.y: Response RMS / median prior5 sessions same-clock response RMS

kind: Outcome-bearing predictive-association development study; NOT data-quality-only or independent OOS
label: NQ 사전 상태와 후속 가격 반응 연구
next_stage: Only if evidence warrants: separately specified pre-entry strategy/feature validation on data not used to select it. Existing Bollinger future reservation remains unchanged.
outcome_policy: All15 dates already consumed development data. This study consumes no untouched future dates; do not call recent5 OOS. Log both hypotheses even if negative.
reference: Strictly prior5 dates, same clock and same feature/response window. Never current day or full-sample normalization.

references.role: Hypothesis-first research, point-in-time availability and avoidance of repeated selection; not evidence these NQ hypotheses work
Repeated-selection overfitting methodology; PBO not computed here

stop: One registered study, report, dashboard ACK and repository publication. No automatic repeated same-data trials, threshold changes, strategy installation, scheduling or orders.
undefined: Flat close path yields undefined signed efficiency; zero reference median yields undefined normalized value/forecast; constant vectors yield undefined correlation, never zero-imputed.
